_comment: Proxy provider registry (armor/proxy/config.py). Data, not code — add a provider by adding a row here, no adapter file needed unless its wire format genuinely differs from both listed adapter types. 'adapter' names a wire-shape adapter type (armor/proxy/adapters/), not the provider itself: most providers here share "openai" because they expose an OpenAI-/v1/chat/completions/-compatible endpoint. base_url has no trailing /v1 — the caller's own request path (after /proxy/<provider>/) supplies the version and route, matching how openai/anthropic already work. Base URLs verified against each provider's own API docs (2026-09-20), not guessed.
